sn12.57:1.2: Saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.57:2.2: tassa puriso kālena kālam mūlāni palisajjeyya || kālena kālam paṃsuṃ dadeyya || kālena kālaṃ udakam dadeyya || ||
sn12.57:2.3: Evañhi so bhikkhave taruṇo rukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyya || || 4
sn12.57:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.57:2.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 5
sn12.57:3.1: Saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.57:3.3: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 6
sn12.57:4.2: Atha puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakam ādāya || So taṃ rukkhaṃ mūle chindeyya mūle chetvā phalikhaṇeyya || phalikhaṇitvā mūlani uddhareyya antamaso usīranāḷamattāni pi so taṃ rukkhaṃ khaṇḍākhaṇḍikam chindeyya khaṇḍākhandikaṃ chetvā phaleyya phāletvā sakalikam sakalikaṃ kareyya sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā vātātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya agginā ḍahetvā masiṃ kareyya masiṃ karitvā vātātape vā opuneyya
sn12.57:4.4: evañhi so bhikkhave taruṇo rukkho ucchinnamūlo assa || tālavatthukato anabhāvakato āyatim anuppādadhammo || || 7
sn12.57:4.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.57:4.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
